narrative: 调度就是音乐本身。舞池、歌舞片，以及某些打斗场地，需要摄影机成为舞伴，而不是旁观记录者。
一个乐句：一次托举、一次转身、一次停顿。节拍结束后多余的花哨动作，会被读作另一个镜头。
它不适合用作常规覆盖镜头。如果只是需要为一句台词拍一个过肩镜头（Over-the-Shoulder Coverage），那就直接拍那句台词。
如果编排运镜偏离了舞者，那就变成了一次游览，而不是一支双人舞。
how: 把演员和摄影机当作一个整体系统来排练：斯坦尼康（Steadicam）、推轨镜头（Dolly）或小摇臂（Jib Shot），地面上标好点位，共享同一节奏。机位高度通常保持在人的视线高度。
舞伴之间以及与场景道具之间的视差（Parallax）变化应当踩在节拍上。提示词：Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.
when: 当一段舞蹈、打斗或行走被写成一个完整的音乐句子时使用。不要用它来给一场没有共享节奏的戏“加分好看”。
vs: 斯坦尼康（Steadicam）是能够承载这个乐句的背心式稳定装置，它是一个平台，而不是理念本身。一镜到底（Oner）关乎时长——一个可能跳舞、也可能不跳舞的长镜头。
如果节拍本身很短，编排运镜也可以很短。
examples_film: 《爱乐之城》（La La Land）让摄影机和舞者共享同一个节拍。《瑟堡的雨伞》（The Umbrellas of Cherbourg）把色彩、舞步与镜头处理成一个共享的乐句。
把它们当作定时调度的语法来使用。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是漫游式的斯坦尼康运镜。破绽在于：舞者已经完成了这个乐句，摄影机却还在继续移动。
解决办法：一个节拍，一个共同的停顿，不要多余的移动。

faq.q: 电影中的编排运镜（Choreo）是什么？
faq.a: 编排运镜是与人物身体共享节拍的摄影机运动：一个动作乐句，然后停顿，仿佛镜头本身就是一位舞伴。

faq.q: 编排运镜（Choreo）与斯坦尼康（Steadicam）的区别
faq.a: 斯坦尼康是一种稳定器；编排运镜则是“调度与镜头共享同一节奏”这一理念，它可以借助背心式稳定器、推轨或小摇臂来实现。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用编排运镜？
faq.a: 用于被写成一个音乐句子的舞蹈、打斗或行走场景。不要把它当作默认的覆盖镜头。

faq.q: 如何为 AI 图像或视频撰写编排运镜的提示词？
faq.a: 描述人物身体与镜头共享一个乐句，然后停顿。示例：Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.

narrative: The blocking is the music. Dance floors, musicals, and some fight halls need the camera to partner, not to report.
One phrase: a lift, a turn, a stop. Extra flourishes after the count read as a different shot.
It is the wrong tool for coverage. If you need an over-the-shoulder for a line, shoot the line.
Choreo that wanders off the dancers is a tour, not a duet.
how: Rehearse actors and camera as one system: steadicam, dolly, or jib, marks on the floor, a shared tempo. Height usually stays human.
Parallax of partners and set pieces should land on the beat. Prompt: Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.
when: Use it when a dance, a fight, or a walk is written as a single musical sentence. Do not use it to pretty-up a scene with no shared rhythm.
vs: Steadicam is the vest that can carry the phrase; it is a platform, not the idea. A Oner is about duration, a long take that may or may not be danced.
Choreo can be short if the count is short.
examples_film: La La Land stages camera and dancers on one count. The Umbrellas of Cherbourg treats color, step, and lens as a shared phrase.
Use them as grammar for timed blocking.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a wandering steadicam. The tell: the camera keeps going after the bodies have finished the phrase.
The fix: one count, a shared stop, no extra travel.

faq.a: Choreo is a camera that shares a count with the bodies: one phrase of movement, then a stop, as if the lens were a dance partner.
Steadicam is a stabilizer. Choreo is the idea that blocking and lens are timed together; it can ride a vest, a dolly, or a jib.
Use it for a dance, a fight, or a walk written as one musical sentence. Do not use it as default coverage.

faq.q: How do I prompt Choreo for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write bodies and lens on one phrase, then stop. Example: Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.
